strengths: Quantity and agreed unit price are editable together; the estimate updates immediately and includes a payment-model note.

issues.observation: One item repeats its price in the product option, next to ‘Agreed price’, and in the input. Stock appears both in the option and an ‘Available now’ badge. Mobile row is about350px; its long select text truncates. Desktop price column is narrow enough to wrap its help over three lines while product select is very wide.
issues.recommendation: Select by product name, show ‘25 available · List $40/eighth’ once below, pair Qty and Unit price, and place Remove in the row corner. Use ‘Subtotal’, ‘Shipping’, ‘Est. total’ and one concise ‘Payment arranged directly’ note.

limits: Clicked Add to reveal a local unsaved row only; no request submitted, quantity or price changed, or data saved.

pass2.notes: Fresh unsaved item-row captures confirm repeated price and availability values, narrow desktop price-help wrapping, and a tall mobile item card. The floating message launcher partly overlaps Add on mobile, matching the independent base-form second-pass observation. Only the local + Add row action was used; no request was submitted.
